'''Falvin Foods''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] manufacturing company<ref name="PSG" /> that operated in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]].<ref name="Sector" /> It bought [[vohis mold]] from [[free-trader]] [[Captain/Legends|captains]] who transported it from [[Gelgelar Free Port/Legends|Gelgelar Free Port]].<ref name="PSG" />
